# Decanter

> Stanford University's design system, delivered as a CSS-first preset for Tailwind CSS v4. Importing it adds the Stanford Identity color palette, typography scales, a pixel-reading spacing system, components, utilities, and custom variants on top of core Tailwind.

Key facts that differ from stock Tailwind CSS:

- Decanter sets the root font size to 62.5%, so rem-based class numbers read as pixels: `text-18` = 18px, `p-16` = 16px, `w-300` = 300px. The spacing unit is `--spacing: 0.1rem`, not Tailwind's default 0.25rem.
- Breakpoints are custom: sm 576px, md 768px, lg 992px, xl 1200px, 2xl 1500px, 3xl 1700px, 4xl 2000px.
- Entry points: `decanter` (everything), `decanter/minimal` (no element base styles), `decanter/forms` (opt-in form styles; requires the main entry), `decanter/colors` (palette tokens only, for projects with their own Tailwind import).
- A single `@import 'decanter';` is the complete setup — it includes Tailwind CSS internally. Do NOT also write `@import 'tailwindcss';`; the duplicate is not removed and ships Tailwind's preflight reset twice.
- Custom variants `hocus:`, `hocus-visible:`, `hocus-within:` (and `group-*` forms) combine hover with a focus state.
- Bare headings h1–h6 follow the responsive modular type scale (h1 = type-5 … h6 = type-0).
- Fonts are NOT bundled or loaded. Decanter only provides font-family utilities (font-sans = Source Sans 3, font-serif = Source Serif 4, font-stanford = the Stanford wordmark font, used by .logo). The consuming project loads the actual font files (Google Fonts + the Stanford media CDN); unloaded families fall back down their stack. See docs/typography.md. (The v7 font-slab/Roboto Slab and font-mono/Roboto Mono families were removed in v8; font-mono still resolves to Tailwind's default system monospace stack.)

## Docs

- [Documentation index and quick-reference table](docs/README.md): Map of all docs plus a table of every class and token Decanter adds to Tailwind
- [Getting Started](docs/getting-started.md): Installation, entry points, composition rules, the 62.5% root convention
- [Colors](docs/colors.md): Complete Stanford palette with tokens, hex values, and contrast guidance
- [Typography](docs/typography.md): Font families, modular type scale (type-0…type-10), fluid type scale, font-size utilities, text styles, line heights
- [Spacing & Layout](docs/spacing-and-layout.md): Spacing scale, responsive spacing (rs-*) value tables, gaps, centered container, breakpoints
- [Components](docs/components.md): button, logo, skiplink, stretched-link, lists, tables, wysiwyg
- [Utilities](docs/utilities.md): Nested link utilities (link-*), legacy text shadows, writing mode
- [Variants](docs/variants.md): hocus, hocus-visible, hocus-within and their group forms
- [Forms](docs/forms.md): The opt-in decanter/forms entry — input, select, textarea, checkbox, radio, label, legend, fieldset

## Optional

- [Upgrade guide](UPGRADE.md): v7 to v8 migration, including renamed and removed classes
- [Development guide](docs/development.md): Repo layout, build scripts, and conventions for working on Decanter itself
